acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer comprehensive design-build services for light-commercial projects. This integrated approach combines architectural design and construction services under a single contract, streamlining communication and accountability. The design-build model fosters collaboration between the client, designer, and contractor from the project's inception, often resulting in faster project completion, cost efficiencies, and a more cohesive overall process compared to traditional design-bid-build methods.
